meta.scope: Turkey Batch 5 — International trade agreements & partnerships densification, education/human capital, and deeper provincial structure (Kocaeli, Bursa, Antalya, Gaziantep).

candidates.title: Türkiye free trade agreement network framing
candidates.description: Overall framing of Türkiye’s network of free trade agreements and preferential arrangements beyond the EU Customs Union. Includes EFTA, UK, South Korea, Singapore, Chile, multiple Western Balkan and Mediterranean partners, and others. Continuously cited in trade-diversification and export analysis.
referenced_by: EU Customs Union and bilateral trade nodes
candidates.notes: System-level FTA architecture node complementing the EU Customs Union.

candidates.title: Türkiye–United Kingdom Free Trade Agreement
candidates.publisher: Governments of Türkiye and the United Kingdom
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA in force since 2021 (continuity arrangement after Brexit). Preserves preferential access previously covered under the EU Customs Union framework.

candidates.title: Türkiye–Korea Free Trade Agreement
candidates.publisher: Governments of Türkiye and Republic of Korea
candidates.description: Bilateral FTA (goods in force 2013; services update later). Supports trade and investment links with a major Asian industrial partner.

candidates.title: Türkiye–EFTA Free Trade Agreement
candidates.publisher: Governments of Türkiye and EFTA states
candidates.description: Long-standing FTA with the European Free Trade Association (updated to include services). Complements the EU Customs Union in the European preferential space.
candidates.notes: European preferential densification beyond the EU.

candidates.title: Education enrolment, literacy and attainment statistics
candidates.publisher: Turkish Statistical Institute / Ministry of National Education related
candidates.description: Official statistics on literacy, mean years of schooling, and tertiary attainment. Literacy is high (~98%); tertiary attainment among younger cohorts has risen sharply (25–34 age group ~45% in recent data).
candidates.notes: Core education and human-capital stock node.

candidates.title: Kocaeli Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Kocaeli — a major industrial and logistics province adjacent to Istanbul, consistently ranking among the top five provincial economies and among the highest in GDP per capita.
referenced_by: Industrial production and Istanbul regional analysis
candidates.notes: Key industrial-province densification east of Istanbul.

candidates.title: Bursa Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Bursa — a major automotive, textile and industrial province ranking among the top five provincial economies.
candidates.notes: Key industrial-province densification in the Marmara region.

candidates.title: Antalya Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Antalya — the principal Mediterranean tourism and services hub, ranking in the upper tier of provincial economies and tightly linked to the national tourism statistics.

candidates.title: Gaziantep Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Gaziantep — a major southeastern industrial and trade hub ranking among the larger provincial economies outside the Marmara–Aegean core.
referenced_by: Provincial ranking and regional disparity analysis

candidates.title: Turkey FTA–education–provincial densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry, TurkStat and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the FTA network framing, key bilateral FTAs (UK, Korea, EFTA), education/literacy/attainment statistics, and the GRDP series for Kocaeli, Bursa, Antalya and Gaziantep into a coherent commerce–human-capital–further-provincial layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
EU Customs Union, tourism, industry and earlier provincial series
